column3: Where is my order?
column4: Track your order from the Orders section using your tracking number.

column3: Can I change my shipping address?
column4: Contact customer support before your order is shipped to request an address change.

column3: My order has not arrived
column4: Check the tracking page for delivery updates. If the estimated date has passed contact support with your order number.

column3: Can I modify an order after placing it?
column4: Order changes may be possible before processing begins. Contact support as soon as possible.

column3: How do I contact customer support?
column4: Visit the Help or Contact Us section on the official website.

column3: I received the wrong product
column4: Contact support with your order number and details of the product received.

column3: My order confirmation email never arrived
column4: Check your spam folder and verify your email address and order history.

column3: Can I cancel my order?
column4: You may be able to cancel before the order is prepared or shipped. Contact support promptly.

column3: How can I download my order receipt?
column4: Open your order history and select the order to look for a receipt or invoice.

column3: Why was my order cancelled?
column4: Check your email for a cancellation notice or contact support for the reason.

column3: How long does delivery take?
column4: Estimated delivery times are displayed at checkout and depend on your location.

column3: My tracking number is not working
column4: Tracking information may take time to update after dispatch. Contact support if the issue continues.

column3: Do you deliver internationally?
column4: Available countries and international shipping fees are shown at checkout.

column3: Can I track an international shipment?
column4: Use the tracking number in your shipping confirmation. Updates may be limited during international transit.

column3: My package says delivered but I did not receive it
column4: Check nearby delivery locations and ask household members. If it is still missing contact the carrier and support.

column3: Can I change my delivery time?
column4: If the carrier supports scheduling use the tracking link to review available delivery options.

column3: Can I change my delivery address after shipping?
column4: Contact the carrier promptly to check whether the delivery address can still be changed.

column3: The delivery address is incomplete
column4: Contact the seller or carrier with your tracking number to check whether the address can be corrected.

column3: How much does shipping cost?
column4: Shipping fees are calculated at checkout based on your location and selected delivery method.

column3: My package is delayed
column4: Check tracking updates and contact the carrier or customer support if the expected delivery date has passed.

column3: How can I return a product?
column4: Open your order history select the item and follow the return instructions.

column3: When will I receive my refund?
column4: Refunds are usually processed after the returned item is received and inspected. Bank processing times may vary.

column3: Can I exchange an item?
column4: Contact customer support with your order number and the item you want to exchange.

column3: The product arrived damaged
column4: Contact support with your order number and photos of the damaged product to discuss available options.

column3: Can I return an item without the original packaging?
column4: Return requirements depend on the store policy and product type. Contact support before shipping it back.

column3: Who pays the return shipping fee?
column4: Return shipping fees depend on the store policy and the reason for the return.

column3: How can I check my return status?
column4: Check your order history or return confirmation. Contact support if there are no updates.

column3: What items are not eligible for return?
column4: Return exclusions depend on the store policy and product type. Review the return policy before submitting a request.

column3: My refund has not arrived
column4: Check your refund confirmation and payment provider processing time. Contact support if the expected period has passed.

column3: Can I return a product purchased on sale?
column4: Sale item return eligibility depends on the store policy. Check the return conditions for your order.

column3: Which payment methods are accepted?
column4: Available payment methods are displayed at checkout and may vary by country.

column3: My payment was declined
column4: Verify your payment details and available funds. Try another payment method or contact your bank.

column3: I was charged twice
column4: Check whether both transactions are completed or one is pending. Contact support if both charges are completed.

column3: Is it safe to pay on your website?
column4: Use the official checkout page and never share your password or verification codes with support agents.

column3: How can I get an invoice?
column4: Check your order confirmation email or order history for an invoice. Contact support if it is unavailable.

column3: Can I pay in a different currency?
column4: Available currencies and conversion details depend on your country and payment provider.

column3: My card was charged but the order failed
column4: Check your order history and transaction status. Contact support with the transaction reference if a completed charge has no order.

column3: My coupon code is not working
column4: Check the expiry date eligibility rules and minimum purchase amount. Ensure the code is entered correctly.

column3: Is cash on delivery available?
column4: Cash on delivery availability depends on your country and delivery address. Check the options at checkout.

column3: How can I update my payment method?
column4: Open your account payment settings if supported or select an available payment method at checkout.

column3: I forgot my password
column4: Select Forgot Password on the sign in page and follow the instructions sent to your registered email.

column3: I cannot log in to my account
column4: Check your email and password and use the password reset option if necessary.

column3: How can I change my email address?
column4: Open account settings and update your email address. You may need to verify the new address.

column3: I did not receive the verification email
column4: Check your spam folder verify your email address and request a new verification email.

column3: How do I update my phone number?
column4: Open account settings and update your phone number if the option is available.

column3: How can I delete my account?
column4: Review account settings for a deletion option or contact support for the account deletion process.

column3: How can I secure my account?
column4: Use a unique strong password enable two factor authentication if available and never share verification codes.

column3: The website is not loading
column4: Check your internet connection refresh the page and try another browser or clear your browser cache.

column3: The app keeps crashing
column4: Update the app restart your device and check for available updates. Contact support if the problem continues.

column3: The checkout page shows an error
column4: Refresh the page check your connection and try another browser. Contact support with the error message if it persists.
